text:
anya: Quick sync  legal asked: when we export change events, can we attach the rollout id + minimal pre-state so "who changed what" is obvious without dumping full objects?

sam: Definitely avoid full snapshots by default. Proposal: include `rollout_id` if present, and a micro-diff array (path + old + new). Add `proof_hash` that covers the diff + metadata.

liam: On storage: store encrypted snapshot blobs for on-demand retrieval. Exports get `snapshot_ref` (opaque token) not raw data. Retrieval goes through an evidence proxy.

nora: UX: show inline diff + "View snapshot" button if user has entitlements. Also surface an estimated MB count before export. :eyes:

devops-bot: export-2765439999 queued by @anya (job=ex-20260322-7a3).

anya: For export API flags: include_diffs=(true|false), snapshots=(none|on_demand|embed), include_rollout_id=(true|false), reason_mode=(hash|redact|raw). Defaults: diffs true, snapshots on_demand, reason_mode hash.

sam: Quota changes: add `export_snapshot_bytes` and `snapshot_downloads` counters. Make on_demand snapshots count against quota estimate at creation so UI can warn.

liam: Proxy vs presigned debate: proxy gives audit + revocation. We should proxy and emit `evidence.download` telemetry with actor id. Cache tokens short-term to reduce load.

anya: Also need to handle system actors (rollout-bot). Export should include `origin_actor_hint` and `human_justification_mode` (hash|redacted|raw) so legal can map intent.

compliance-bot: Reminder: hashed justifications are acceptable for chain-of-custody; plaintext retrieval requires approval and stricter key handling.

nora: Console will add a "Legal package" preset that sets snapshots=embed and opens a modal explaining retention and size. We'll surface a link to request plaintext justification access.

devops-bot: export-2765439999 done (size=3.9MB, snapshots=0.6MB, records=197).

anya: Thanks all, I'll write RFC with NDJSON sample line and sequence diagram (export -> proxy -> audit log) and tag @security and @legal for review.
